title: 4231 Cold Springs, COPPERAS COVE, TX- Ben Atkinson Homes- Homestead Real Estate
description:
4231 COLD SPRINGS
COPPERAS COVE, TX

4BDR/3BA
2712 SQFT

This beautiful Ben Atkinson Home truly stands out with its 2,712 square feet of thoughtfully designed space. With 3 bedrooms and a study, it offers both comfort and functionality. As you walk in, the raised ceilings and recessed lighting create a bright, welcoming ambiance. The large living area, perfect for hosting, features a cozy brick wood-burning fireplace and flows seamlessly into the kitchen. The kitchen itself is a chef's dream, with a kitchen island, built-in oven, microwave, and an electric cooktop. The large walk-in pantry and eat-in kitchen make it ideal for both casual meals and special occasions. The primary suite offers a luxurious retreat with an en suite bathroom, complete with a soaking tub, a walk-in shower, and a spacious walk-in closet. The secondary bedrooms are generously sized with ample closet space, ensuring comfort for everyone. This home seems perfect for a blend of luxury and practicality! Come see for yourself!
